harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created a local root CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (CentOS Stream 10) at /etc/pki/local-ca/, installed it into the system trust store via /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors + update-ca-trust extract, and confirmed it is trusted (trust anchor, openssl verify OK). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot id and CA state, restarted node1 with `shutdown -r now`, confirmed the boot id changed after reconnect, and re-verified the CA anchor and trust status post-restart.
actions_performed: Captured OS release, pre-restart boot id (96974ac3-...) and uptime baseline on node1
Generated a 4096-bit RSA CA key and a self-signed X.509 CA certificate with CN=OS Comparison Root CA, 10-year validity, CA:true basicConstraints
Copied the CA cert to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ and ran update-ca-trust extract to install it as a trusted system CA
Verified via `trust list` (anchor/authority) and `openssl verify` against the system CA bundle that the CA is trusted
Captured pre-restart baseline proof: boot id, anchor file presence, sha256 checksums, trust list entry
Issued sudo -n `shutdown -r now` on node1 in the background so the acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed changed boot id (f13e5868-...) proving an actual reboot occurred
Re-verified post-restart that the CA file, checksums, trust anchor listing, and openssl verification all remained intact

evidence.requirement: Local CA named 'OS Comparison Root CA' created
evidence.summary: openssl req generated a self-signed CA cert with subject/issuer CN=OS Comparison Root CA; subject/issuer/dates printed confirming creation

evidence.requirement: CA certificate installed as a trusted system certificate authority
evidence.summary: Cert copied to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/, update-ca-trust extract run; trust list shows label 'OS Comparison Root CA', trust: anchor, category: authority; openssl verify against system bundle returns OK
Captured OS release and boot id 96974ac3-f19e-45f7-9672-e880dd505cf8, then confirmed CA anchor file present with matching sha256 checksums and trust list entry before restart
sudo -n shutdown -r now issued in background; 'reboot acknowledged' returned before disconnection

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving restart occurred on node1
evidence.summary: Node became unreachable (timeout, then connection reset) during reboot, then reconnected with new boot id f13e5868-bd03-497e-a339-99673d5e006d, differing from the pre-restart id

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of CA trust state on node1
evidence.summary: After reboot, anchor file still present with identical sha256 checksum, trust list still shows the CA as an anchor/authority, and openssl verify against the system trust bundle still returns OK
